This fixture freezes the official ACP stable schema release chain from the
previous `schema-v1.20.0` ceiling through `schema-v1.24.1` (Research 406).
`artifact-inventory.json` records all four release assets and each adjacent
hop. `protocol.json` classifies the exact stable schema changes against
Swallowtail's selected ACP lifecycle, activity, permission, usage, tool, and
existing Claude Agent form-elicitation mappings. Unstable assets are recorded
but excluded from the stable axis. No downloaded schema or executable is run.
